subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot merge safe Markdown chunks into one message bubble when the combined payload stays under the verified QQ API safe limit, or should the current one-message-per-complete-Markdown-chunk behavior remain the supported contract?
rationale: Current source preserves split chunks, a linked PR proposes send-boundary merging, another open PR proposes chunker-layer merging, and a member comment says splitting is intentional, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent channel behavior.

options.title: Merge safe chunks
options.body: Adopt one bounded implementation path after proving live QQ safe-size delivery, overflow behavior, and fallback semantics.

options.title: Keep intentional splitting
options.body: Treat current self-contained chunk delivery as the contract and close or reject the merge-chunks PRs with a documented rationale.

options.title: Define an explicit policy surface
options.body: Add a documented QQBot chunking policy only if maintainers want users to choose between compact bubbles and conservative split delivery.

recommendation.title: Merge safe chunks
recommendation.body: Adopt one bounded implementation path after proving live QQ safe-size delivery, overflow behavior, and fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: They are listed for QQ/Chinese channels, authored the current chunker behavior, are assigned to the linked PR, and provided the by-design comment.
